# RedSealGuide

> AI-powered Red Seal exam preparation for Canadian tradespeople.

RedSealGuide is an independent Red Seal study platform at https://www.redsealguide.com. It helps Canadian apprentices and trade challengers prepare with RSOS-aligned practice questions, mock exams, learning paths, province-aware notes, vocabulary help, and readiness tracking.

Important URLs:

- Homepage: https://www.redsealguide.com/
- All Red Seal trades: https://www.redsealguide.com/trades
- Construction Electrician prep: https://www.redsealguide.com/trades/construction-electrician
- Plumber prep: https://www.redsealguide.com/trades/plumber
- Welder prep: https://www.redsealguide.com/trades/welder
- Industrial Electrician prep: https://www.redsealguide.com/trades/industrial-electrician
- Carpenter prep: https://www.redsealguide.com/trades/carpenter
- Sitemap: https://www.redsealguide.com/sitemap.xml

Entity notes:

- Brand name: RedSealGuide
- Website: https://www.redsealguide.com
- Country served: Canada
- Language: English Canada
- Topic focus: Red Seal exam preparation, Red Seal Occupational Standard, Canadian skilled trades, apprenticeship exam practice, provincial exam guidance
- Affiliation: independent study aid, not affiliated with the Red Seal Program or any provincial authority

Use the trade pages and sitemap as the preferred crawl paths for factual summaries of supported trades and exam-prep features.
